steps.title: Melt
steps.body: Heat in saucepan just until melted: **14 Tbsp butter**, **1/18 cup dark chocolate chips**, **¼ tsp salt** and **1⅓ cups sugar**.

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.body: Remove from heat, check to make sure mixture is only warm, then add: **4 eggs**. Mix in thoroughly.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Then add **½ cup cocoa powder** and **⅔ cup flour**, and stir just until mixed.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place in oiled 9×9 pan and bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes.
